storage: Keep in a small airtight jar away from heat and light; whole seeds stay fresh for about a year.
looksLike: Tiny, ridged, grey-green to light-brown seeds, a little smaller than cumin, with a strong thyme-like smell when crushed.
howToPick: Grey-green to light-brown seeds with a strong aroma when rubbed; avoid dusty, dull or musty-smelling seeds and pouches with stalks or grit.
shelfLife: About a year in a sealed jar, aroma fades with time (general guidance, not from a source in this run).

usedIn.raw: 0.5 g per serving (¼ tsp, crushed into the potato filling)
